decision_headline: V2-native compact-to-expanded model is the primary path. Legacy parity preserved as informational secondary path.
why_native: 76.6% of current missing observation dims are LEGACY_V3_EXTRA_NO_V2_SOURCE — unreachable through V2 lanes without building parallel publishers.
Time-to-evidence is short on the 224-dim per-symbol V2 surface that is already wired and tested.
No policy architecture port required upfront.
Aligns with capital-protection-first doctrine after operator capital loss.
what_is_blocked: Policy architecture port start is blocked.
Exchange order / cancel / modify is blocked.
operator_decisions_required: Approve the V2-native edge-proof gate (paper-only soak; no canary).
Set 10 numeric capital protection caps in capital_recovery_gate_model.json.
Decide whether to start the legacy policy architecture port in parallel (optional).
Decide each external feed individually (token metrics, onchain BTC, onchain ETH, CCXT OHLCV, paid CoinAnk aggregator).
Approve the paper-edge certification threshold (min trade count, min after-cost expectancy, drawdown bounds).
Approve the V2-vs-legacy decision-match certification threshold (informational only).
next_automatable_tasks: Author the V2-native compact-to-expanded training spec.
Wire a paper-soak evaluator that emits rolling after-cost expectancy + drawdown bounds.
Route every training/evaluation artifact through Codex review.
Continue read-only V2-vs-legacy comparator (informational, not a gate).
Keep executive command center / self-healing controller / report center / remaining-dim queue current.
required_visible_text: Candidate symbols are not adopted automatically.
Recovery requires proof of edge before scaling.
